Class Worker

java.lang.Object
depot.system.core.Worker
public class Worker extends Object
Represents a worker in the Depot System. Workers are responsible for processing customers and managing parcels.

  • Constructor Details

    • Worker

      public Worker(String workerID, String name)
      Constructs a Worker object with the specified ID and name.
      Parameters:
      workerID - the unique ID of the worker; must start with 'W' followed by digits.
      name - the name of the worker; cannot be null or empty.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the workerID or name is invalid.

  • Method Details

    • processCustomer

      public void processCustomer(Customer customer, ParcelMap parcelMap, Log log)
      Processes a customer's parcel, marking it as collected, calculating fees, logging the transaction, and adding the parcel to the collected parcels list.
      Parameters:
      customer - the customer whose parcel is being processed.
      parcelMap - the map containing parcels and their statuses.
      log - the log to record processing details.

    • calculateFee

      public double calculateFee(Parcel parcel)
      Calculates the total fee for a parcel based on its weight, storage time, and any applicable discounts. The fees are combined and any discounts are applied by a separated function based on the days in depot.
      Parameters:
      parcel - the parcel for which the fee is calculated.
      Returns:
      the total fee after applying discounts.
